paragraphs.text: The Gods' Eye is a legendary tower located in the Sokenzan mountains on the plane of Kamigawa . During the time of the Kami War , the Gods' Eye was a tower on Kamigawa that was known as the Gate to the Reikai - the land of the Kami . It was said that once inside, if you listened to its walls you could hear the whispers of the kami. It is not known if this was just superstition or if it had some connection to the spirit world. It is also unknown if the tower survived the war and is still around presently.
